title: Wonderful Museum + Beach Day
text: Great experience! We are staying in Barcelona and were having trouble figuring out the best way to get up to Dali’s museum, so we sprung for the private tour and we’re so glad we did. Pickup was seamless, as was entry to the museum, and Noelia indulged all our questions about Dali on the way up. In the museum, she showed us some of the highlights and then we had some time to explore the museum on our own. Her knowledge about Dali’s life and his works is very impressive! After the museum, we drove out to the most beautiful town in Costa Brava, where Noelia found us some quiet beaches to soak up
author: M3027OQkatieb

title: Noelia Brought Dalí to Life!
text: Noelia was absolutely fantastic! She’s incredibly knowledgeable, genuinely passionate about Dalí, and so much fun to spend time with. Her enthusiasm was infectious, and she brought the art to life in a way that made the entire museum experience more meaningful and memorable. She has a gift for sharing her knowledge without ever making it feel like a lecture—just a fascinating, lively conversation. I loved the tour and couldn’t recommend her more highly. Book with Noelia—you’ll be glad you did!
author: C1339CQkeithh

title: A Must Do Tour
text: This was such an amazing event. The museum was amazing, the drive was smooth, the wait times were exceptional, and prices very reasonable. Our tour guide, Noelia, was SPECTACULAR! Not only was she super kind and easy to talk to but she had the sense of also being interested in our tour, which is not easy to find with a lot of guides. She added so much perspective into this whole tour and with her background of Dali that we could have engaging conversations the ENTIRE TIME we were with her. The lunch was fantastic and fresh with such relaxing beach time after which was much needed after the pre
author: Cody_A

title: Our guide Noelle was...
text: Our guide Noelle was great. She was very pleasant and tried to make the tour at Dali museum very interesting and kid-friendly for our 4 year old son, which we really appreciated. She is very knowledgeable and we had a very good experience with her.
author: ShiehLin_L

title: Awesome time with Anatoli at Dali’s museum Gerona!
text: Analtoli was great!! We were impressed by his knowledge and professionalism when we visited Dali’s museum in Girona province. He took the time to explain in amazing detail and the importance of Salvatore Dali’s work. He was very passionate, organized, accommodating and patient. He made our trip go smooth  and we’re glad we took the tour!
author: 645tatyanay

title: No stress with this guide and driver.
text: Guide and driver on time. Guide was exceptionally informative and thoughtful to our requests. Highly recommend.
author: Toni_S

title: Hello Dali!
text: Ruben was an amazing guide. He detailed the amazing life of Salvatore Dali, his loves, experiences and relationships as if it were a movie or a good book. The drive up had a lot of traffic, but the ride back along the coast and farmland was much nicer. All said, Ruben made the private tour worth the extra cost. The knowledge we gained from his on point information will be with us for ever.
author: Alan E

title: Adventure with Ventura
text: Touring Figueres and Girona. Ventura was extremely knowledgeable and interesting especially concerning the museum of Salvador Dalí
author: Paige_H

title: Fun day in the countryside
text: Such a fun day. The guided tour inside the Dali museum was amazing. And the countryside and Costa Brava beaches are so beautiful. We are so happy we booked this tour.
author: Abbey_H

title: A wonderful time
text: We had such a great time on this tour. Miquel made the museum unforgettable and showed us all the tricks. He is a fantastic guide. The Costa Brava is gorgeous and made a perfect afternoon.
author: abbeyhansen
